name: Shlink
description: A URL shortener with visit statistics and an API; the domain is what every short link starts with.

access.note: Nothing signs in here through a browser. Shlink is the redirect engine and the REST API; it ships no admin interface, so opening https://<your domain>/ returns Shlink's own "not found" response rather than a login page. Reveal the initial API key from the Variables tab and send it as the X-Api-Key header, or paste it into a separately hosted Shlink web client pointed at this address. The key is created only on the first start of an empty database.
